rules_changed.rule: chi-square probes along every principal axis AND every pairwise diagonal (2p^2); a converged refit with a lower objective inside the separation radius refuses NOT_A_LOCAL_MINIMUM
rules_changed.effect_on_this_record: MULTI SUPPORTED was established over 4 axis probes. Re-measured over 8 probes without multistart: nonlinearity index 0.0715047 (unchanged; the maximum lies on an axis), minimum chi-square rise 3.75363, no reason added. The committed refits' chi-square values are not below the estimate's, so the lower-objective rule would not fire on them, but the refits were not re-run.

rules_changed.rule: predictive probes along axes, pairwise diagonals and Sigma grad g per prediction
rules_changed.effect_on_this_record: C2 predictive SUPPORTED was established over axis probes only; re-measured (see HUQ-11).

rules_changed.rule: predictive nonlinearity scaled by parameter sd, not total sd
rules_changed.effect_on_this_record: C2 nonlinearity was 0.036 total sd; re-measured 0.05658 parameter sd, below the 0.10 downgrade threshold.

rules_changed.rule: a multistart below max(6, 2p + 2) starts caps the claim at DOWNGRADED
rules_changed.effect_on_this_record: the script's policy is 6 starts at p = 2, exactly the minimum (max_evaluations=400 is not part of it; 2 of the 6 committed refits failed, so more than half converged), so no downgrade is projected.

rules_changed.rule: a log coordinate's identifiability width is its natural-scale relative width
rules_changed.effect_on_this_record: k0_declared_log: the ln k0 width is now exp(q sd) - exp(-q sd) ~ 0.645 instead of 2 q sd / |ln k0| ~ 0.030; the status stays PARAMETERS_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE (condition number and correlation both exceed their thresholds).
MULTI_v2.route.record_digest and every embedded record's digest no longer reproduce (with HUQ-01's policy keys in thresholds).

rules_changed.rule: the minimum multistart search includes max_evaluations and maximum_retractions (a value below the canonical policy's is a recorded shortfall), and a search is incomplete unless at least max(6, 2p + 2) starts CONVERGED, not merely half of those proposed. A refit that does not converge under a budget below the canonical one is retried once at the canonical budget.
rules_changed.effect_on_this_record: MULTI_v2 is the record the re-audit cites for this problem (REAUDIT_2026-09-16.json R-08). Its policy is 6 starts at p = 2 with max_evaluations=400 (kinetics.py:257), and 2 of the 6 committed refits are CALIBRATION_FAILED. Under these rules it projects DOWNGRADED on two independent counts: the budget of 400 is below the canonical 2000, and 4 converged where 6 are required. The committed route record carries no multistart policy keys in its thresholds, so on read-back the uniqueness it states (MULTISTART_NO_SECOND_MODE) no longer follows from the 4 of 6 starts it lists and the record is refused rather than re-derived -- a strictness increase on an already superseded record, not a regression. The two failed refits would now each be retried at 2000 evaluations, which is exactly the multistart cost this stream must not pay. The record's bytes and its SUPERSEDED status are unchanged and the multistart was NOT re-run.

rules_changed.rule: a start the forward model refuses is REPLACED by the next unused point of the same Halton sequence, from one counter shared by every start, instead of being halved toward the calibrated estimate. The entry records `replacements` and no longer records `retractions`.
rules_changed.effect_on_this_record: every committed MULTI_v2 entry records retractions 0, so no start was pulled toward the estimate and the span each one searched is the span the record implies. The key name in the committed bytes is the old one; nothing reads it.

rules_changed.rule: a separated converged refit that is not a BETTER_OPTIMUM is SECOND_MODE when its Laplace mass ratio exp(-(chi - chi_min) / 2) * sqrt(det(Sigma) / det(Sigma_min)) exceeds MULTISTART_MASS_FLOOR = 1e-3 and WORSE_LOCAL_OPTIMUM when it does not, and the ratio is recorded so a reader can re-derive the classification.
rules_changed.effect_on_this_record: MULTI_v2 holds one separated converged refit, at chi-square 2699.72 against the estimate's 5.4446 and a Mahalanobis distance of 12446.6, classified WORSE_LOCAL_OPTIMUM. Its height ratio alone is exp(-1347.1), far below the floor, so no covariance at that optimum could lift it above 1e-3 -- the classification is projected UNCHANGED. The record carries no laplace_mass_ratio; because it carries no multistart policy either, the read-back's mass rule does not apply to it (the rule is gated on the policy record, which postdates these bytes). The refit was NOT re-run.

unchanged: the MULTI estimate and standard deviations (identical when re-derived without multistart), covariance, determinant and correlation, identifiability statuses (declared NOT_IDENTIFIABLE, aligned WEAKLY_IDENTIFIABLE), the C2 predictive parameter and total sd, the reference grids (Core V1, unaffected), the CORRECTED errata quantities, WEAK_C2 REFUSED (NO_RESIDUAL_DEGREES_OF_FREEDOM), and the natural_k0_identity REFUSED / k0_declared_log DOWNGRADED parameterization verdicts.
